sbom.note: Generated at release time from the checked-out release commit and published as an attested workflow artifact; not tracked in git, because a committed file cannot record the hash of the commit containing it. Excluded from SHA256SUMS: its inventory is built from SHA256SUMS, so checksumming it there would be circular. Deterministic for a fixed commit (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH or HEAD commit time).

provenance.note: Attestation is produced by the release-attest workflow, which must be dispatched from the immutable release tag. The workflow binds expected tag -> expected commit -> checked-out HEAD -> attested subjects before attesting, and its gh attestation verify step is authoritative: verification failure fails the release-integrity gate. There is no DEFERRED outcome. available=false until a verified attestation exists for the published candidate; workflow_ready=true means the workflow is present and validated in-tree.

note: Checksums are integrity hashes from SHA256SUMS, not cryptographic signatures. This manifest describes the v2.4.0 candidate identity with immutable git_ref vPROJECT_VERSION and never mutable main. Dev channel (DRLINK_RELEASE_CHANNEL=dev or FRP_RELEASE_CHANNEL=dev) remains explicit opt-in via main after the tag. Top-level artifacts list official install/uninstall scripts; self-contained bundle manifests are separate and must not self-reference. Integrity (SHA256), SBOM (SPDX JSON), and GitHub Artifact Attestation are distinct evidence classes. Pretags / development trees pin git_ref and source_head to the exact HEAD SHA; never advertise a future stable tag before it exists. features.mcp_included=true after MCP Bridge/AI Access implementation.

supply_chain.tag_policy: Published tags are immutable and are never moved, deleted, recreated, retargeted, or force-pushed. A wrong tag is superseded by a new version tag.
supply_chain.artifact_integrity: SHA256SUMS verified by project-update before execution
supply_chain.artifact_ordering: scripts/build-release-artifacts.sh: build bundles -> update SHA256SUMS -> generate SBOM -> verify
supply_chain.sbom: SPDX JSON via scripts/generate-sbom.py, gated by scripts/verify-sbom.sh
distinctions: developer commit signing is not required for this release evidence set
